presets.name: General object detection
presets.description: Watch for common objects using a general-purpose model.
presets.guidance: Check the live detections to see which objects the model recognises. Choose a specialised preset or model when needed.

presets.name: Calving signs
presets.guidance: Keep the cow’s rear and the floor behind her clearly visible. Detection can miss events; keep your usual animal checks.

presets.name: Cow mounting behaviour
presets.guidance: Use a clear side view with the animals’ full bodies visible.
